prompt:
A close-up of a 1980s wooden television cabinet with its sliding shutter doors half open on a softly glowing blank screen, a lace doily and a small vase on top. Painted like a 1980s Indian family-magazine illustration in flat gouache: warm teak browns, faded teal and cream with one signal orange, soft grain, nostalgic Sunday light. Wide panoramic composition: the main subject sits in the left third of the frame. Towards the right the same scene carries on, quieter and darker: open sky, distance and shadow, nothing important there, one continuous picture with no panels and no split. Full-bleed edge to edge, no border, no frame, no people, no faces, no hands. No text, no letters, no numbers, no words, no logos, no badges, no religious symbols, no writing anywhere.
